name: pagination-animated
title: Pagination (animated)
description: A horizontal page switcher with Previous and Next arrows, numbered links and an ellipsis. The rounded highlight marking the current page slides to the link you choose instead of blinking across.
use: A long list or table is split into pages and the current page should stay obvious while you page through.
avoid: The recorded demo fixes the row at five pages and an inert ellipsis, so real page counts need the markup rebuilt.
a11y: Links are real anchors with aria-current and named Previous and Next; reduced motion swaps the slide for a crossfade. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On a black stage, one thin row: a Previous link with a left chevron, the numbers 1 to 5 spaced evenly, a three-dot ellipsis, then Next with a right chevron. The active number sits in a soft grey rounded rectangle slightly lighter than the bare links.
behaves: Clicking a number, Previous or Next moves the grey highlight to that link, easing it across the row with a short spring rather than hiding and reappearing. Hovering a link tints its background faintly; otherwise the row is still.
customise: Compose the row from Root, links, Previous, Next and Ellipsis, and pass a transition to Root. Page state and click handlers are yours; colours come from the button styles it wraps.
weight: light: A handful of links plus one absolutely placed highlight that only animates on a page change.
demo: Pages 1 to 5 with Previous, Next and a more-pages ellipsis.
issues: The more-pages ellipsis is a plain span with no handler, so clicking it does nothing.
polishWhy: Even spacing and a tidy sliding highlight; the demo is only a five-page row.
